## 2. Core Projects & Ventures
1. **LifeHub AI (https://lifehub-ai.my.id/)**

   - **Tech Stack:** JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase Authentication, Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline caching.

2. **NEXUS AI OFFICE / NEXUS Kantor AI**
   - **Role:** System Concept Architect.

   - **Status:** Architectural concept and interactive visual prototype.

3. **AURA GLOBAL (https://auraglobal.my.id/)**
   - **Role:** Founder & Lead Web Developer.
   - **Description:** A digital web development studio based in Majalengka providing affordable, high-performance, and SEO-friendly websites for MSMEs (UMKM), company profiles, and WhatsApp-integrated digital stores.
